name: Mizraim
overview: Scripture identifies Mizraim as a son of Ham, situating him within the genealogical framework of Genesis 10 and 1 Chronicles 1. He is noted as the progenitor of several groups, including Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, and Naphtuhim, emphasizing his role in the origins of various peoples. These passages highlight the biblical foundation for understanding Mizraim’s place in God’s sovereign design over nations.
